description.value: Full-service oceanfront RV resort and marina on Georgia Strait between Campbell River and Courtenay, with flush showers, heated pool, hot tub, and boat launch; tenting is in designated areas only and rates reflect the resort setting.

address.value: 2176 Salmon Point Road, Campbell River B.C. Canada V9H 1E5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and is the primary evidence source. OSM tags (drinking_water=yes, power_supply=yes, toilets=yes) are corroborated by the website's descriptions of full hook-up RV sites and washroom facilities. The amenities and rates pages confirm tent camping, free hot showers, commercial laundry, an on-site store, and a restaurant, making this a solid candidate for touring cyclists.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone listed; both were sourced from the website (address: 2176 Salmon Point Road, Campbell River BC V9H 1E5; phone: 1-250-923-6605).
OSM category is caravan_site (RV-focused) but tent camping is confirmed available in designated areas — the listing is relevant to non-motorized tourists.
Laundry is open 'by appointment' only — may be less convenient for drop-in touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, year-round coastal campground with tent sites, hot showers, laundry, on-site food, and a store — a strong fit for touring cyclists on the Vancouver Island route.
